state.name: auth

why: The await loads modules. The mounted third-party auth API uses graph-owned database and mail resources, creates no owned connection or timer here, and has no close API. Core owns its async build; ADR 0103 names the handler exception.

why: Subscription, reader, close flags, and replay cursor are private protocol and IO lifetime state. Saved application records live in SQL and frontend cells.

state.name: eventStream

why: The stop listener sets ended and closes the subscription before async open work resumes. A body constructed after abort closes in start when ended is true. Pull also checks ended before reading or emitting. Existing opening-stop and held-stream tests cover both paths.
